title: Review: kith-jmap + kith-chat (loop 6)
notes:
Confidence: 15% chance of missed bug. Uncertainty driven by: (1) kith-store internals not reviewed here — get_changes_since_ordered contract and ChangeSet semantics are assumed correct from callers; (2) no actual runtime test of concurrent Peer/deliver vs Message/set race — the analysis is logical not empirical; (3) the duplicate-attachment-blob-id rollback test (line 2672) relies on a PRIMARY KEY constraint violation on attachments.id but this is (msg_id, blob_id) or just blob_id? Did not verify the schema. Would raise confidence if: integration tests covering concurrent delivery + set were added; schema for attachments table confirmed PRIMARY KEY is on (message_id, blob_id) pair not blob_id alone.
Maintainer risk: MEDIUM — Two code paths (create/update parsing in contact.rs and message.rs) silently accept malformed input as no-ops rather than returning invalidArguments. The post-commit read failure in Message/set create is a P0 lie-to-client bug. The sentAt validation gap will cause UI corruption if a client or test passes a bad timestamp. Everything else is documentation/style.
